title: Untitled (Multi-Panel Collage)
description: Multi-panel collage assembled from overlapping rectangular sections pinned to a white wall, incorporating compact discs, bullseye targets, a heart motif, soccer balls, chess pieces, and ribbon stripes. Red paint strokes and tape unite disparate printed, photographic, and foil fragments across the composite surface.
composition: multi-panel overlapping rectangular sections on wall
keywords: compact disc bullseye soccer ball assemblage
